description: This file is a Makefile fragment used in the OpenWrt build system, defining download methods, version handling, and integrity checks for package sources.

methods.name: dl_method_git
methods.description: Determines download method based on URL for git repositories, returning 'github_archive' or 'git'.

methods.name: dl_method
methods.description: Guesses the download method based on URL and protocol, supporting git, svn, hg, bzr, darcs, and others.

methods.name: dl_pack
methods.description: Selects the compression method for creating tarballs from checkouts based on file extension.

methods.name: dl_tar_pack
methods.description: Creates a tarball from a directory with specific options and compression.

methods.name: gen_sha256sum
methods.description: Generates SHA256 checksum for a given file in the download directory.

methods.name: check_download_integrity
methods.description: Checks the integrity of downloaded files by comparing hashes and marks files as checked.

methods.name: check_warn_nofix
methods.description: Outputs a warning message without fixing issues.

methods.name: check_warn
methods.description: Outputs a warning message, optionally fixing issues if FIXUP is enabled.

methods.name: F_hash_deprecated
methods.description: Script path for fixing deprecated hash usage.

methods.name: F_hash_mismatch
methods.description: Script path for fixing hash mismatches.

methods.name: F_hash_missing
methods.description: Script path for fixing missing hashes.

methods.name: check_hash
methods.description: Checks the hash of a file against expected value, issuing warnings if mismatched or missing.

methods.name: check_md5
methods.description: Checks MD5 hash, deprecated in favor of SHA256.

methods.name: hash_var
methods.description: Determines whether to use MD5SUM or HASH variable.

methods.name: DownloadMethod/unknown
methods.description: Placeholder for unknown download method.

methods.name: DownloadMethod/default
methods.description: Default download method invoking download.pl script.

methods.name: wrap_mirror
methods.description: Wraps download commands with mirror support and hash verification.

methods.name: DownloadMethod/svn
methods.description: Defines SVN checkout method.

methods.name: DownloadMethod/git
methods.description: Defines Git checkout method.

methods.name: DownloadMethod/github_archive
methods.description: Defines GitHub archive download method.

methods.name: DownloadMethod/rawgit
methods.description: Defines raw Git checkout and archive creation.

methods.name: DownloadMethod/bzr
methods.description: Defines Bazaar checkout method.

methods.name: DownloadMethod/hg
methods.description: Defines Mercurial checkout method.

methods.name: DownloadMethod/darcs
methods.description: Defines Darcs checkout method.

methods.name: Validate/svn
methods.description: Validation rule for SVN source version and subdirectory.

methods.name: Validate/git
methods.description: Validation rule for Git source version and subdirectory.

methods.name: Validate/bzr
methods.description: Validation rule for Bazaar source version and subdirectory.

methods.name: Validate/hg
methods.description: Validation rule for Mercurial source version and subdirectory.

methods.name: Validate/darcs
methods.description: Validation rule for Darcs source version and subdirectory.

methods.name: Download/Defaults
methods.description: Sets default parameters for download.

methods.name: Download/default
methods.description: Defines default download parameters based on package variables.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Main macro to perform download with dependency checks, integrity verification, and method selection.
